codelines.evidence: Opened src/fares.ts, which defines Rider, BASE_FARE_CENTS (350), CONCESSION_FARE_CENTS (175), and fareFor(rider). The comment states riders aged 65 AND OVER pay concession, but the code checks `rider.age > 65`, so a rider of exactly 65 falls through to the adult fare — matching MOCK3-1 exactly. Also opened test/fares.test.ts to see existing test coverage shape for this module. No stop/departure-board related files exist in this codeline (only fares.ts and its test).

Opened src/schedule.ts, which defines Stop, formatStops(stops), and totalMinutes(stops). formatStops loops `for (let i = 0; i < stops.length - 1; i++)`, which excludes the final stop from the rendered output — matching MOCK3-2 exactly. totalMinutes correctly reads the last stop's minutes, consistent with the ticket's note that duration reporting is unaffected. Also opened test/schedule.test.ts to see existing test coverage shape. No fare/rider-related files exist in this codeline (only schedule.ts and its test).

recommendedInvestigators.focus: The age-boundary comparison in the fare calculation logic and its existing test coverage for boundary ages
recommendedInvestigators.why: src/fares.ts contains fareFor() with an off-by-boundary comparison (age > 65) that contradicts its own stated rule (age >= 65), directly matching MOCK3-1

recommendedInvestigators.focus: The stop-iteration loop bound in the departure board rendering logic and how it interacts with totalMinutes
recommendedInvestigators.why: src/schedule.ts contains formatStops() whose loop bound (stops.length - 1) drops the final stop from output while totalMinutes() correctly reads the last stop, directly matching MOCK3-2
